paper.title: Neural quantum states for non-Abelian lattice gauge theories with dynamical fermions
paper.authors: Gabriel Rouxinol, Julian Bender, Michele Grossi, Patrick Emonts, Jad C. Halimeh

results.system_description: 2+1D SU(2) lattice gauge theory with staggered fermions on the 4x4 periodic lattice; g^2 = 20, lambda = 0.2, t = 0.5, m = 1; half filling (N_f = 16); constant N lambda omitted
results.method: Gauge-invariant NQS (Jastrow and convolutional network for the links, gauge-covariant Gaussian fermions)
results.variant: gauge wavefunction: two-body Jastrow and CNN; fermions: gauge-covariant Gaussian state on a Néel reference
results.source_location: Table tab:high_coupling_benchmark_tab, row t = 0.5, m = 1, column e_alg
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy per site of the optimized state (gauge wavefunction from a Jastrow factor and a convolutional neural network, times a gauge-covariant fermionic Gaussian state), obtained by VMC.
results.notes: Printed as energy ± Monte Carlo error; e_alg = E/N with the constant N lambda of H_B omitted (table caption). The e_PT column is strong-coupling perturbation theory solved by exact diagonalization, an approximation, not a bound. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
